title: When the Sigil Burns Anew
author: Orsen Nystrom
blurb: Theo Delacroix, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
